# Hale Path Packaging (UK)
 
> Hale Path Packaging is a UK-based custom packaging manufacturer with a 32,000 sq ft in-house production facility in Bromsgrove, West Midlands. The company designs and produces custom corrugated, rigid, and flexible packaging — mailer boxes, retail-ready boxes, rigid gift boxes, mylar pouches, and printed cartons — for brands in cosmetics, food & beverage, CBD, e-commerce, tobacco, pharmaceuticals, pet products, and more. Materials include FSC-certified, recyclable, biodegradable, and compostable options. Standard production lead time is 11–14 business days, with capacity up to 500,000 mixed-category units per day. Serves the UK (with delivery across England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland) plus international customers in Europe, North America, Asia-Pacific, and the Middle East & Africa.

## Packaging Categories (by structure/type)
- [Custom Packaging (overview)](https://halepathpackaging.co.uk/custom-packaging/)
- [Corrugated Packaging](https://halepathpackaging.co.uk/corrugated-packaging): Custom corrugated boxes, mailers, and shipping cartons, produced in-house from raw liner and fluting.
- [Rigid & Premium Boxes](https://halepathpackaging.co.uk/custom-rigid-boxes/): Rigid gift, presentation, and luxury boxes.
- [Flexible Packaging](https://halepathpackaging.co.uk/flexible-packaging): Stand-up pouches, mylar bags, and flexible film packaging.
